answer_summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI assistants to securely connect to external data sources and tools, enhancing their capabilities. ([cube.dev](https://cube.dev/docs/product/apis-integrations/mcp-server?utm_source=openai))

Synapse offers an MCP server that allows AI assistants to directly query Synapse, facilitating tasks such as searching for datasets, inspecting entity metadata, exploring project hierarchies, and tracing provenance without the need for additional code. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

To access the Synapse MCP server, you can use the hosted endpoint at `https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp`, which authenticates via OAuth2, eliminating the need for token management. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

Alternatively, for environments requiring air-gapped setups or development purposes, you can run the server locally using a Personal Access Token (PAT). ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))
